task: Implement the /login screen from MoMorph screen GzbNeVGJHz and wire Google OAuth through a local Supabase project, scoped to the login screen and session only.
acceptanceCriteria: /login is reachable while the prelaunch launch gate is locked, and renders the header logo, language selector, ROOT FURTHER hero, intro copy, LOGIN With Google button and copyright footer
Clicking the login button initiates Google OAuth via Supabase authorize with provider=google and a redirect_to pointing at /auth/callback, in the same tab
The login button is disabled and reports aria-busy while authentication is in flight
A failed or cancelled authentication renders the fixed Vietnamese error string in a role=alert region
An already-authenticated visitor to /login is redirected to /
/login and /auth/callback are exempt from the prelaunch launch gate in both the locked and unlocked directions, and the gate remains launch-timing only, never authorization
Supabase session refresh is merged into the single Next 16 proxy.ts and refreshed auth cookies survive a gate redirect rather than being silently dropped
No secret key is reachable from client code, getUser is used in every server context rather than getSession, and no real credential is committed
blastRadius: The merged proxy.ts runs on every non-asset request app-wide, so a fault there reaches every route, not just /login. lib/prelaunch/gate.ts governs the launch lock for the whole site. The i18n dictionaries are shared by every existing screen. Everything else is new and reachable only via /login or /auth/callback. lib/session/session-provider.tsx is deliberately untouched and remains a non-security client mock alongside the new real auth boundary.
contracts: Track A to Track B seam: components/login/* are presentational only and must never import @/lib/supabase/*; LoginButton is controlled via loading and onClick and sets disabled plus aria-busy

Accessible-name freeze asserted by the E2E: button name 'LOGIN With Google', header logo alt 'Sun* Annual Awards 2025' with no link or button ancestor, hero logo alt 'ROOT FURTHER', role=alert text 'Dang nhap khong thanh cong. Vui long thu lai.'
resolveGateRedirect stays a pure clock-injected function with no auth awareness
